description: This file defines a class ADODB2_sybase for handling Sybase database operations within the ADOdb PHP library, including methods for type mapping, SQL generation for schema modifications, and index management.

classes.name: ADODB2_sybase
classes.description: A class extending ADODB_DataDict for Sybase-specific database schema operations.

methods.name: MetaType
methods.description: Maps PHP data types to Sybase-specific type codes.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Returns the actual SQL data type for a given meta type.

methods.name: AddColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to add columns to a table.

methods.name: AlterColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to alter columns in a table.

methods.name: DropColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to drop columns from a table.

methods.name: _createSuffix
methods.description: Creates SQL suffix for column definitions based on attributes.

methods.name: _IndexSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to create or drop indexes.
